noodle_queen.judgment: TASTE + FUNCTION + CONTEMPT PASS: the frozen high-B / low-sweeping-A contradiction is the memorable center; anticipation and consequence are not metronomic; silhouette phases are distinct; COM counterweight and planted feet make intent embodied; the release visibly spends phase debt; the repair is economical without looking like placeholder tweening.

iterations.correction: Author K10 as a still-offset restack with COM one cell left, B still settling, A still low-lag; add two deterministic SMOOTHSTEP recovery bridge frames into K0 while preserving bilateral foot contact.
iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: Recovery collapsed into the exact READY silhouette: K10 was visually identical to K0, so the cycle paid no visible recovery debt and read as a generic idle reset.

iterations.judgment: Actual render now reads as coil -> one-tick A snap -> B apex/read -> one-tick freeze latch -> long B-held/A-sweep counterweight -> A overshoot/deceleration -> one-tick release -> B catch-up overshoot -> rebound/secondary lag -> offset restack. Support remains planted, spacing is asymmetric, and the loop returns through paid recovery instead of reverse interpolation or idle reset.
